mechanism: Artifact-identity mass is not invariant to taxonomy refinement. In a partial-overlap support hypergraph, no context-independent package-weight vector can generally preserve all support while making semantic-context exposure invariant. Therefore a representation-invariant controller must factor through semantic support before assigning mass/credit to package implementations.

upstream_curriculum: precomputed support/applicability fingerprints from frozen first-party validators or released task-support evidence
skill-level quality/exploration/decay statistics available before task generation
frozen semantic support prior / anchor distribution
upstream_forbidden_baseline_information: the generated task that does not yet exist
decision_time_information_contract.post_context_retrieval_credit: Task context/outcome becomes available and must be shared identically with contextual baselines.

algorithm.name: Build support quotient
algorithm.description: From the frozen task/support incidence matrix, collapse exact support-equivalent implementations and form support atoms/cells whose identity depends on semantic applicability rather than package count. The P0 uses exact first-party validator support only; no learned similarity threshold is tuned on outcomes.

algorithm.name: Allocate semantic control mass
algorithm.description: Place curriculum/retrieval/update mass on support atoms under a frozen semantic prior. Package multiplicity cannot create new atom mass.

algorithm.name: Choose implementation conditionally
algorithm.description: Within an atom, distribute its unit mass among compatible implementations using only the same pre-decision quality/exploration evidence available to baselines; member responsibilities sum to one.

algorithm.name: Realize upstream generation with a shared non-novel backend
algorithm.description: For generative curricula, the selected support atom must constrain realization rather than collapse back to an unconstrained global package draw. Use a first-party support-conditioned proposer interface if the author exposes one; otherwise use validator-gated/rejection realization under a preregistered matched call budget. This realization backend is not claimed as novel. If neither faithful backend exists, upstream quotient control is not operationally identified on that substrate.

algorithm.name: Quotient credit
algorithm.description: After independently verified feedback, update semantic support/atom statistics once and distribute responsibility across compatible implementations with total responsibility one. Splitting one implementation cannot multiply total future credit.

algorithm.name: Transformation audit
algorithm.description: Before scale-up, apply frozen semantics-preserving clone/split/merge/overlap transformations and require the SQC control process to remain within preregistered representation-distance tolerance while semantic coverage is unchanged.

strongest_same_information_baselines.name: optimal-global-support-aware-weighting
strongest_same_information_baselines.information: same support matrix and pre-task stats
strongest_same_information_baselines.status: already falsified on released Skill-SP support matrix for exact exposure equalization; optimum max/min ratio=2.0

strongest_same_information_baselines.name: generic-pre-context-single-package-controller
strongest_same_information_baselines.information: same library/support fingerprints/quality-exploration stats and sampling budget; no future task lookahead
strongest_same_information_baselines.reduction: Released Skill-SP selects exactly one package before task generation. Any randomized same-information controller therefore induces only a categorical package-weight vector at the frozen state, so the tight global-weight lower bound applies to the full rule/MLP/bandit/neural single-package class.

strongest_same_information_baselines.name: matched-validator-rejection-sampling
strongest_same_information_baselines.information: same target support atom and same first-party validators
strongest_same_information_baselines.budget: same proposer/validator call budget as quotient control
strongest_same_information_baselines.role: Use rejection sampling as the default generic realization implementation when no native support-conditioned proposer exists. Do not claim a specialized SQC realization advantage over this backend.

strongest_same_information_baselines.name: context-conditioned-simplex-router
strongest_same_information_baselines.information: same task context, support fingerprints, quality/outcome evidence, clone quotienting, capacity and fixed budget
strongest_same_information_baselines.stop_rule: If it matches SQC on retrieval/credit invariance and downstream utility, drop that SQC component.

formal_targets: Refinement-dependence lemma for positive artifact-ID mass.

Tight partial-overlap lower bound: if two active packages each have an exclusive-support context and share an overlap context, then every nonnegative context-independent package-weight controller has max/min context exposure ratio >=2. The released Skill-SP graph supplies two witnesses and the LP optimum equals 2.
Support-quotient invariance proposition under exact support-equivalence and a frozen semantic support measure.
Credit conservation proposition: total semantic credit is invariant to implementation split when responsibility weights sum to one.
method_success_condition: The support-quotient control core must remove the qualified native taxonomy sensitivity on a real/public dynamic substrate while using a faithful shared realization backend, preserving semantic coverage and staying within the matched proposer/validator call and evolution-utility budget. Control-plane algebra alone is not enough for C3.
method_failure_conditions: faithful qualified native dynamic substrate shows no representation sensitivity
support-quotient control cannot be realized within the matched proposer/validator call budget
support-quotient control obtains invariance only by reducing semantic coverage or verified evolution utility
the support fingerprints or quotient prior use information unavailable at the upstream decision time
contextual router matches the optional post-context retrieval/credit extension, in which case that extension is dropped
next_action: Freeze one faithful author-workflow P0 in which rejection/validator gating is a shared backend, not a competing claimed method. Test only native taxonomy sensitivity plus whether support-quotient control removes it within matched coverage/call/utility constraints. Do not train an upstream neural single-package baseline; that class is already analytically reduced.
